about_the_game:
WELCOME, SURVIVOR!

Hello Survivor, glad you made it! My solo-dev survival game is coming to Early Access soon. It’s raw—bugs and rough spots included—but your help can shape it. Join the community, share your ideas, and let’s craft something epic together!

CHOOSE YOUR SIDE

Pick your faction and dive into the struggle. Whether fighting for the ideals of collective progress or championing individual freedom, every battle is a test of resilience, strategy, and sometimes just plain luck. The choices you make—what you equip and how you fight—can determine if you live to see another day. I’m excited to see how you play, and your feedback will help steer where this journey takes us!

SURVIVE

Survive the onslaught and reach extraction. Trapped in a hostile battlefield, you must withstand waves of enemy factions while managing your limited resources. Min-max your equipment, wield powerful Nanite-based abilities, and adapt to escalating threats as you fight against time and overwhelming odds. Tell me what works, what doesn’t, and let’s make it better together.

A FRACTURED FUTURE

In a dystopian world ruled by the wealthy elite, society is torn between left-wing loyalists in sprawling mega-cities and right-wing patriots resisting in the untamed wilds. As chaos spreads, powerful entities like BioNex and the Neo Elite Forum deploy ruthless Davos MaxTac mercenaries to enforce their agenda, leaving humanity locked in a desperate fight for survival. I’m building this world one update at a time, and your ideas will directly impact how this fractured future evolves.

FUTURE UPDATES

This is just the start! I’ve got big plans brewing—new weapons to wield, tougher enemies and epic bosses to face, loyal companions to fight alongside, vehicles to tear through the wilds, and fresh game modes to test your skills. With your input, we’ll shape these updates together. What do you want to see next? Let’s make it happen!

A QUICK NOTE FROM GRIM:

This is just the start—Early Access means it’s far from finished. I’m a one-person team pouring my heart into this, and I’d love for you to join the ride. Share your ideas with the community, join in on the polls and together, we’ll Make Awesome Games Again—your voice matters here.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10/11 64 bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-6600, 3.3 GHz or AMD Ryzen 5 1500X, 3.5 GHz
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 750 Ti (Maxwell or newer), 2 GB or AMD Radeon R7 360, 2 GB
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Minimum System Requirements may change.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10/11 64 bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-11600K, 3.9 GHz or AMD Ryzen 5 5600X, 3.7 GHz or Greater
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1070, 8 GB or AMD Radeon RX 590, 8 GB or Greater
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 4 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Recommended System Requirements may change.
